description: A cowboy rides through a dusty town at sunset, high-angle cinematic shot.

spec.subject: A lone adult cowboy, lean build, wearing a weathered tan felt hat, faded denim shirt, dark leather vest, worn jeans, and scuffed leather boots, riding a brown horse with a dusty saddle and bedroll.
spec.setting: A small frontier town street at sunset, packed dirt road with a thin veil of dust in the air, wooden storefronts lining both sides, hitching posts and a few barrels along the edges, long shadows stretching across the street, background buildings softened by dust and warm light.
spec.action: The cowboy rides steadily down the center of the street at an easy trot, the horse’s hooves kicking up a light plume of dust.
spec.camera_angle: High-angle, three-quarter front view, wide shot, 35mm lens, looking down from above the street with the rider placed slightly below center frame.
spec.camera_movement: Slow descending crane move, keeping the rider centered while lowering slightly as he passes through frame.
spec.lighting: Sunset backlight from low behind the buildings, warm amber-orange key with soft side fill from the open sky, moderate contrast, long shadows, dust catching the light, no visible artificial practicals.
spec.style: Digital capture with fine grain, warm sepia-orange color grade, classic western look with crisp dust detail and long-shadow composition.

human.critique: low angle from the ground, not high angle
